subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five public memory roles, including per-agent overrides and hook-level role gating, as its permanent memory plugin and configuration contract?
rationale: Implementation review cannot decide the long-term product taxonomy, inheritance semantics, compatibility window, and SDK commitment created by these new public surfaces.

options.title: Sponsor the five-role contract
options.body: Approve the proposed role taxonomy in principle, then require conflict resolution and exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, Doctor, CLI, and Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Land only roles with complete runtime semantics, such as recall, capture, and compaction, while deferring dreaming or user-model ownership until their invocation contracts are defined.

options.title: Pause this architecture
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open but do not land this branch until maintainers choose a different composition model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the five-role contract
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed role taxonomy in principle, then require conflict resolution and exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, Doctor, CLI, and Gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest available owner for a permanent cross-cutting public config and Plugin SDK decision.
